author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Runs a cross-platform Fan Crown using Twitch/Kick rewards and Viewer Foundation points on YouTube/TikTok, with clear rules on who can claim it and a private monthly leaderboard.
changelog: 4.1.68: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.68, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 1.0.0: initial release with fixed or multiplier price progression, a hard cost cap, current-holder and per-user cooldown rules, optional stream reset, local-calendar monthly rollover, points-spent ranking, reign tracking, editable chat messages, a styled hosted overlay card, and separate controller/reset Streamer.bot actions.

manifest.name: Fan Crown
installationSteps: Import the separate Fan Crown Streamer.bot package.
Keep its Controller action triggerless and approve only that action for this add-on.
Keep Twitch and Kick Reward Redemption attached to your existing main platform actions.
Create Twitch and Kick rewards. The saved YouTube, TikTok and Facebook command registers automatically after restart.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its compact private season state remains preserved for a later reinstall.

healthChecks.description: Checks that crown claims are handled one at a time, reward changes match each result, prices stay within limits, and the private monthly ranking is saved.
